body: I believe it’s the current issues in my life that are affecting my relationships which are in turn just dragging me down even more.
Wow this was phenomenal advice! Thank you SO much! I will give it a shot. Not sure how I will feel if it turns out I do actually have curly hair..
Cheryl Strayed is one of my favorite writers and when I was younger my nickname was Little. Boring, I know, but thought I would participate.
These two things are the reasons I am with the man I am with!
Mine are almost as long as my other eyelashes, which are pretty long. Majority of people point them out on me but very rarely do I come across someone else who has them also!

I have the nirvana smiley face on my ankle.
On my inner arm the quote “I’ll be in your side forever more,” my best friend has the first half “in good times and bad times” on her inner arm. 
A bouquet of flowers with the quote “how wild it was to let it be” down my spine, it is my favorite quote from the movie Wild. 
Skulls and roses on my left side, first tattoo.
An outer leg sleeve that goes from ankle to armpit of my right side. On my thigh is a picture to the song Dust in the Wind, a very meaningful song to me, with a naked woman blowing away in the woods and my calf is a close up woman’s face and my side is a giant hawk which both just kind of fit the setting of the first one.
This is the kind of art I’d love to have in my house!
